Snacks and Desserts 473
| BANANA ICE CREAM | ICE CREAM
Blenderized frozen bananas taste amazingly like ice cream. The next time
you are confronted with too many ripe bananas, peel them, cut them into
1/2-inch (1.3 cm) slices, lay them on a flat pan, and place them in the freezer
for an hour or so. Once frozen, they are ready to be made into banana
“ice cream.” You can then be creative with the mix-ins. Here are examples:

¢ Blend in peanut butter, honey, or frozen berries.

¢ Sprinkle chopped walnuts, mini chocolate chips, or fresh berries
on top.

© Drizzle a little chocolate sauce on top.

¢ Make banana “frozen yogurt” by freezing Greek yogurt in ice
cube trays, and then tossing a few cubes into the blender along
with the bananas.
